notes.title: Alpha has Started
notes.content:
Alpha has launched and the feedback is very positive!

I'm having a really good time exchanging and communicating with testers.

So far, I got people I know trying out the game. At Some moment I will switch to beta and invite more players. Players who are helping me out are going to have their names in the credits.

The game keeps growing! I'm implementing a lot of new ideas and past suggestions in the game.

THINGS LIKE:

 - Units now have a health bar AND a food bar. In nature ants store food in their abdomen that they can after share with other ants that are in need. When a worker brings back food to the colony, he finds a replete or the queen and gives the food in the storing ant. This food is later use to get health back or use to feed the eggs and larva.

- The player can only see his colony when underground. I added a very nice fog that matches the underground that prevents form seeing to infinity. The player can also only zoom out as far as he as dug + a reasonable player distance.

- The player can start Quests! There's a Panel that allows to start different quests. Things like : Summon 3 spiders and kill them in 3 minutes,  Or : prevent all beetles from reaching the other side. Funs stuff!!

- A very descriptive Tutorial allowing new players to fully grasp everything that can be done. It's a step by step tutorial with unlockable zones.

WORK IN PROGRESS
- balance units
- balance the economy
- 90 % of saving/loading has been completed. Not certain of i will allow eggs to be saved, because of cheating.
- Sound and music is at 0%. Im still looking for a good soundtrack, unit and ambient sounds have been found and they sound very good.

Thank you

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.content:
Hi all!!

this saturday I was a the MIGF ( Montrel Independent Game Festival ) and it was so much fun! A lot of people showed up, I had a stand to let people try out the game and they jsut loved it! Some people actually voted Ant Queen as their favorite!!!

So thank you again for the great support. All of this is possible thanks to all the players that keep helping me to fix and upgrade the game.

About this patch 3.3

Story Mode :
 - The Queen should stop moving in randomize destinations
 - Level 1 - The collider that makes the game succesfull was too small. It will   detect more easily when the queen reaches the hole.
 - Level 2 - The Path finding was too precise and some ants where getting stuck in the inside colony. Should not happen anymore
 - Level 19 - The Ui Icon to get outside the  red ant colony were acting weird... replaced them with what the should be.

Unlimited / Sandbox:
 - Queen starts with 100Hp in easy, 80 in Medium,50 in hard
 - Easy mode is easier. Red ants spawning rate is slower and they do less damage
 
Thanks again and let me know i f you see something

Next patch
- fix the achivement system fixed
- Unlimited NPC spawn rate nerf

notes.title: Patch 2.7 - Green Ants galore
notes.content:
Hi community and players,

We are continuing our frequent updates and giving a player a wish : a more costly but yet more powerful ant type - the green ants !

Also, we did crushed some bugs, as appropriate for ants masterz, and made minor adjustments to both the story mode and the sandbox :
- blue, red and yellow ants are 25% more expensive
- green ants are an additional 25% compared to other ants
- we added a UI cue for ants' costs
- the new patrol system is now also available in story mode
- workers use less CPU and memory while doing the same job (good efficient workers is what a Queen likes !)
- achievements have been added for the green ants
- music has been added for the sandbox mode

TODO : 
- add survival mode to the sandbox (with scoring)
- balance green ants compared to the rest

REQUEST TO PLAYERS : a player has noticed a crash at the end of level 15 in story mode that would be due to garbage collection (GC error message) :
- we would appreciate any player encountering it sending a PM or a comment here 
- any player that would feel like testing it, we would love to get feedback if it happens to you

We hope you continue enjoy the game, do not hesitate to post comment and suggestions as usual !

notes.title: Patch 2.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

SandBox:
 - In this patch, we added the option for the players to set patrol points rather than having the ants patrol between the nest and foraging zones. 
 - the player can click on a new UI flag button and after click on the ground to set an orange flag. Soldiers and Super Soldiers will patrol between does points and the colony.
 - Flags cannot be set on water, rocks or on the players nest.
 - the player can delete all patrol flags with a UI button.
 - When red ants go inside the colony, the player's ants that are insided the colony will rush to defend from the intruders. The queen will be the last one to die.
- If the player has no more nursers, the first nursers can become mature on it's own.
- There is always atleast one RedAnt Nurser.
- Red ants that are in their colony, are harder to kill and do more damage
- Made a mix of the songs to not have the same song on loop

StoryMode
 - fixed level 10 victory condition. Sorry...

This Working on
 - Adding a 5th type of ant, the green ants. These ants will be more expansive and overall better than other ants.
 - Add a box for the mini-map
 - Add a second Red Ant Colony in the Hard Sandbox mode
 - Add a survival mode in the sandbox
 - Add achivements for the sandbox

Thank you again for all of your input
inVantage

notes.title: SandBox Beta is ready!

We need players who would like to try it!!

 - all features can be saved and loaded
 - the map is random

 - you can dig how you want!

 - red ants count is saved
 - controls have be ajusted

 - set a max number of ants for low end computers
 - set max number of red ants, also for low end computers

notes.title: SandBox progress
notes.content:
Hello fellow players,
 
SandBox mode is being worked on and it's so much fun!!!

So far :
 - The map is new every time you start a new Game.
 - You can save your game - load and all rocks,plants,vines,etc. are recored and stay at the same place when you load your saved game.
 - If you start a new game and save, the old game is "deleted";
 - At the beginning of a new level, you start with the queen only and you have a new Icon, the colony Icon, you click on it and with you mouse you can place it on the map. This will place your colony where you want it.
 - The colony position is also saved and the random red ant colony position is also saved (if you save...).
 - once you are inside your colony, you have the option to lay eggs and the first nurser you will spawn will develop automatically to adult, it can be a black,yellow,red or blue nurser. 

Working on:
 - the new digging system where you can dig your own tunnels and set what the food,egg,larva,cocoon chambers positons will be.
 - the NPC spawning. This will be easy since it's already made. Just need to chose what NPC to spawn.
 -The max ants you will be able to spawn. Since the map is humongous. We need to test out what a low end computer can support. 

Since this is becoming more of a community project. I would like to hear your ideas. Now's the time to add things you think will make the gameplay better!

Thank you
Invantage
